build.front: plastic (inner screen), Gorilla Glass Victus 2 (3.4 inch cover screen)

software.os: Android 14, One UI 6.1.1, upgradable to Android 17

camera.reason: 50MP OIS main and a 12MP ultrawide, with no telephoto.

performance.reason: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy is a previous generation flagship chip that still runs every game smoothly.

battery.reason: 4,000mAh gets through a day only with moderate use and charges at 25W.

display.reason: 6.7 inch foldable LTPO AMOLED at 2,600 nits plus a 3.4 inch cover screen.

build.reason: Aluminium frame and Victus 2 back, but the inner screen is plastic and IP48 offers little dust protection.

value.reason: The cheapest PTA flip phone at 305,000, but S26 phones give a better camera and battery for similar money.

availability.reason: In stock at PriceOye and sold by Samsung Pakistan, with official Samsung service centres.

notes: PriceOye lists the 12GB 512GB at 304,999 in stock on 2026-10-11. Samsung Pakistan lists the Flip6 at 384,999 (WhatMobile shows the same). The display figures are for the inner screen; the cover screen is a 3.4 inch 60Hz Super AMOLED. Galaxy Z Flip7 is not officially sold in Pakistan and no PTA approved listing was found.
